River monitoring report

The monitoring team measured river levels at twelve stations after three days of heavy rainfall. The published report preserves the complete measurements and explains how residents can use the readings to prepare for changing conditions.

Researchers compared the new readings with the long-term record and found that water receded more slowly near the eastern bridge. The report describes the sampling method, the observed trend, and the limits of the current forecast.

Crews will publish another update after the next scheduled survey. Until then, local officials advise residents to check the marked crossings before traveling through the low-lying area.
